notes_summary: Mid-market product org evaluating hosted API for speed of trial, then Dedicated for production; primary workload is nightly batch embed jobs + high-qps semantic search for product search with geo data residency requirement.
detailed_notes: Intro call 2025-10-05 — interested in drop-in hosted API to reduce setup time. AE (Ava) intro, SE (Jordan) on call.
Demo 2025-11-12 — showed hosted embeddings and similarity search flow; CanvasFold liked streaming and token-level cost transparency.

POC scope agreed 2026-01-15 — two-week hosted POC: 1) batch embed pipeline for 4M docs (nightly), 2) low-latency product search queries (target p50 < 45ms), 3) vector DB integration (Pgvector + Pinecone trial).
Security review started 2026-01-20 — needs SSO (SAML), audit logs retention 1 year, KMS integration, and data residency in us-east-1. Legal asked for data residency clause in contract.
Throughput note: engineering expects 800-1200 QPS for search front door during peak plus batch job ingest ~120k docs/hour. Want throughput baselining answers from Redwood Dedicated sizing.
Quote/price deck shared 2026-02-25 (drive link). Finance needs 12-month committed pricing for Dedicated to compare to current cloud GPU spend.
Fireflies call FF-2026-02-20-1123 — product lead: 'we need reproducible embeddings and consistent recall across releases'. Asked about model pinning and rollout policies.
SE performed ingest test on hosted API 2026-03-01 — saw median embed latency 22ms; batch throttling observed at file ingest 2.5k docs/min; Jordan requested tuning guidance from Optimize team.
POC metrics to gather: p50/p95 search latency, tokens/sec cost breakdown, embedding throughput, failure rates during batch runs.
Legal/Procurement: NDA signed; draft SOW waiting on data residency contract language (blocker).
Customer quote: 'Hosted API gets us started quickly — if Dedicated matches throughput/cost we will move to a 12mo commit.'
Integration note: primary vector DB choices under consideration: managed Pinecone for ease, Postgres+pgvector for long-term cost control; need Redwood ops patterns for each.
Jira INF-4243 opened for request: 'Dedicated capacity sizing for nightly batch + 1k QPS search' — engineering waiting on sizing estimate.
Requested features: automatic KV/prefix caching for hot product subsets, canary rollout between model variants, and token-level cost visibility per route.
Customer prefers model family: meta-llama-2-13b (open) and lighter 7B variants for embedding experiments; wants Redwood to recommend quantization profile for Dedicated GPUs.
Retention ask: can we disable storing raw request payloads in hosted logs? Short-term they want redaction + long-term SSO + dedicated control plane (Private) as optional.
Next demo scheduled 2026-03-14 — walk through Dedicated sizing + cost tradeoffs; include Optimize team for batching recommendations.
